name: md any where
subtitle: AI 编辑与三端 Markdown 写作
promotional_text: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上编辑 Markdown、预览公式并导出文稿。可选 Agent 使用您配置的服务，每次远程发送前由您确认。
keywords: markdown,latex,写作,公式,笔记,文稿,编辑器,排版
description:
md any where 是支持 macOS、iPhone 和 iPad 的 Markdown 与 AI 写作编辑器。无需创建 md any where 账户，即可编辑文稿、查看离线预览并导出文件。

写作与预览
• 多标签编辑、查找替换、撤销与操作记录
• 标题大纲、表格、任务列表、代码高亮
• 离线 LaTeX 公式与常用流程图语法预览
• iPhone 与 iPad 触摸布局、软键盘和横竖屏适配

文件与导出
• 通过系统“文件”打开、保存和分享 Markdown
• 本机草稿恢复，继续处理未完成的文稿
• 导出 HTML、PDF 和标准 DOCX
• DOCX 可设置中英文字体、页边距、行距和可编辑数学公式；复杂格式以实际导出效果为准

可选 Agent
自行配置兼容的服务端点、模型和 API Key，执行润色、校对、总结或多步骤工作流。所有 Agent 默认停用，每次远程发送前展示接收方与发送范围并由您明确同意。服务商可能收取费用并按其政策保存请求；应用不提供内置模型额度，也不要求启用 Agent 才能编辑。

普通编辑、预览和导出在设备上完成；API Key 持久保存于系统钥匙串。选择外部文件提供商或运行 Agent 时，相关服务按其政策处理数据。

源码采用 MIT 许可，第三方组件保留各自许可。

三端与 AI 编辑器
同一开源项目提供 macOS、iPhone 和 iPad 版本。macOS 版可通过 MCP / CLI 接入 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等兼容 AI 编辑器；本 iPhone/iPad 应用使用内置 Agent，不包含桌面 IDE 或 macOS 命令行宿主。文稿跨设备传递可使用系统文件服务，应用不提供自营云同步。
review_notes:
md any where 1.0.0 (6) is a Markdown editor for iPhone and iPad. No md any where account, subscription or purchase is required for local editing, offline preview, Files integration, draft recovery or export. There are no ads or in-app purchases.

Review the local features by creating a document containing a heading, list, table and $x^2$, switching to preview, using the Document menu to save/export HTML, PDF or DOCX, and backgrounding/reopening the app to inspect draft recovery. The interface follows the system language and can be changed in Settings.

Optional AI is a bring-your-own-service client, disabled by default. The publisher does not operate an AI server, issue service accounts, provide model credits or embed an API key. In Document > Settings and Agents, users enter their own compatible endpoint, model and credential, save and enable the profile, select text and open Agent to run a writing task. API use is governed by the selected provider's account, regional, age and billing requirements. There is no publisher demo credential for this external service path. Please contact the review contact if additional access or evidence is required for this client architecture.

Every remote run names its destination and data scope and requires explicit consent; Cancel sends nothing. Credentials are kept in Keychain, requests go directly to the configured endpoint, and automatic HTTP redirects are rejected. Some actions send a selection/context; summaries and full-document workflows can send the entire document. Privacy labels cover the optional provider path, including provider-retained content, account identifiers, usage and technical logs; the publisher receives none of these API requests. Provider policies differ and may include model improvement. No advertising tracking is implemented.

The app has no public content feed, user-to-user messaging or unrestricted in-app web browsing. Its supplied content and writing templates contain no mature topics. Optional generated content depends on the user's task/provider; the app does not claim a universal moderation layer. It is a general writing utility, not a Kids-category app.

The macOS MCP/CLI helper and Finder extensions described in the project are not included in this iPhone/iPad binary. Documents can be transferred using system file providers; there is no publisher-operated cloud sync. Distribution is free and excludes mainland China. Release remains manual after approval.
